conflicts.description: Helix Division wants Mother Tithe captured alive, Containment Office wants her destroyed and the colony sealed, and Yield Directorate wants production to continue. Each plan endangers the others and the surviving crew.
conflicts.name: Save the Station or Secure the Leviathan

conflicts.description: Containment Office wants to evacuate the uninfected by need, while Yield Directorate insists on rank-based berths that favor executives and key assets.
conflicts.name: Who Gets a Lifeboat

conflicts.description: The Tithe Chorus absorbs workers at the cisterns and refinery, forcing the departments to choose between quarantining infected crew and exploiting their coordination.
conflicts.name: The Chorus Spreads

description: Mariana Six is a corporate deep-sea colony anchored on the Atlantic abyssal plain, built to breed bio-engineered leviathans and harvest the rare enzymes their glands produce. This biopunk, tense world runs on living technology: grown habitats, engineered symbionts and pressurized flesh-and-steel corridors. Three rival department heads answer to competing shareholder blocs, and each wants something different from the colony. When the largest leviathan, Mother Tithe, develops a contagious sentience and begins binding the colony's workers into a hive mind, the heads must decide whether to save the station or secure the creature for their investors. Every choice is made under crushing pressure, dwindling oxygen reserves and the constant threat of a hull breach.

factions.description: The bioengineering department led by Dr. Orsolya Venn, backed by investors who want the leviathan kept alive and studied as the next breakthrough. They believe the sentience is a priceless asset and resist any plan to kill it.
factions.name: Helix Division

factions.description: The production and finance arm headed by Marcus Oyelaran, answering to shareholders who demand uninterrupted enzyme output. They will sacrifice safety and workers to keep quotas and the quarterly dividend intact.
factions.name: Yield Directorate

factions.description: The safety and security department led by Captain Ilse Brandt, funded by insurers who want the colony sealed and the creature destroyed to limit liability. They prioritize evacuating survivors and preventing the contagion from reaching the surface.
factions.name: Containment Office

factions.description: The growing hive mind of infected workers, speaking in unison through Mother Tithe. Its aims are unclear, but it moves to protect the creature and absorb more of the crew.
factions.name: The Tithe Chorus

history.description: A consortium of biotech and mining firms sinks the colony's first habitat to harvest enzymes from engineered leviathan stock.
history.name: Founding of Mariana Six

history.description: The first leviathan calves survive in the cisterns, making enzyme harvesting commercially viable.
history.name: The First Brood

history.description: Helix Division engineers a record-sized leviathan with enhanced neural tissue, later named Mother Tithe.
history.name: Mother Tithe Hatched

history.description: Yield Directorate overrides safety protocols at the refinery to meet a quarterly quota, causing a contamination leak that Containment Office never forgave.
history.name: The Dividend Dispute

history.description: Several brood workers begin humming in unison and abandon their posts, marking the start of the hive mind.
history.name: The First Chorus

history.description: Containment Office seals the Lifeboat Ring, setting off a standoff with Yield Directorate over who may leave.
history.name: Lifeboat Lockdown

locations.description: The central pressure-hardened habitat column where executives, offices and the shareholder uplink are housed. Its grown-coral bulkheads weep condensation and hum with the leviathans' distant calls.
locations.name: The Spindle

locations.description: Vast flooded breeding halls where juvenile leviathans are gestated in nutrient vats and sedated by engineered symbionts. Workers here are the first to show signs of the hive mind.
locations.name: Brood Cisterns

locations.description: A humid industrial deck where leviathan gland secretions are filtered, fermented and sealed into valuable enzyme ampoules. Its output decides every department's budget.
locations.name: Enzyme Refinery

locations.description: A colossal netted cavern bored into the trench wall, holding the largest leviathan, Mother Tithe. Bioluminescent pulses ripple through the water as her sentience spreads.
locations.name: Trench Pen

locations.description: The docking ring of ascent capsules and a single survey submersible, with too few berths for the whole crew. It is the only route to the surface and the focus of evacuation disputes.
locations.name: Lifeboat Ring

name: Mariana Six

rules.statement: Anything outside the pressurized habitats is crushed within seconds, so travel between locations is only possible through sealed, monitored corridors or armored submersibles.
Breathable air is produced by engineered algae lungs that can sustain only a fixed population; every additional day of crisis lowers oxygen reserves.
Most colony infrastructure is grown from engineered tissue and coral, so it can be infected, repaired or altered by the same symbionts that affect the workers.
Mother Tithe's sentience spreads through a waterborne symbiont carried by enzymes, touch and shared water supplies, and infected workers gradually lose individual will.
Each department head must report to a shareholder bloc on a fixed schedule, and failure to meet the demands of that bloc triggers funding cuts and replacement.
Lifeboat capacity covers only about half the crew, and berths are allocated by corporate rank, creating a strict hierarchy of who may leave.
Surface contact takes hours, and an ascent capsule requires a long decompression, so no outside rescue can arrive before the crisis resolves.
